title: Big Eddy Campground

services.name: Crib Cabin
services.desc: We’ve had a busy spring here at Big Eddy, and we wanted to take 5 and share about one of our exciting projects we’ve been working on. Over the winter, a long-time visitor and fisherman of the West Branch donated funds to Chewonki and we purchased a third cozy cabin! If you’ve stayed in any of our cabins, you know how popular they are. Whether it’s a reprieve from the black flies, a roof over your head, or a mattress to sleep on - the reasons folks enjoy them are many. Adding more cabins and making upgrades to the fleet is part of our long-term upgrades at the campground, so receiving this donation was much appreciated and exciting. The new Caddis Cabin is nearly identical to POC 1 and 2

blurb: The area north of Millinocket is a vast sweep of forest, dotted with lakes and ledge, and cut by one of the most fabled rivers in Maine, the West Branch of the Penobscot. This is Thoreau country, the setting for the journeys described in Henry David Thoreau’s The Maine Woods.
